sentences.en: Today, I went to the market to buy two melons.
sentences.zh: 今天我去市场买了两个甜瓜。

sentences.en: The melons they grow in this area taste very good.
sentences.zh: 这个地区的甜瓜味道非常好。

sentences.en: This melon sounds hollow. Maybe that's why it was so cheap.
sentences.zh: 这个甜瓜听起来是空心的。也许这就是它这么便宜的原因。

senses.zh: 瓜；甜瓜；大肚子；圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西
